cardOverview.overviewText: A premium IRCTC Premier card delivering accelerated train travel rewards, milestone benefits, and enhanced privileges for frequent travelers.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Insurance coverage worth 50 lakhs against an air accident. insurance coverage worth 10 lakhs against a railway accident.|fraud liability cover of 1 lakh.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, immediately report the incident to SBI Customer Care at 1800 1234, 1800 2100, or 1800 112211. For email support, contact customercare@sbi.co.in
